hook.text: An app uses 200 open-source libraries. One has a critical flaw. The team doesn't even know it's there.

buildup.text: Modern apps depend on hundreds of libraries, each with their own dependencies and potential flaws.

discovery.text: Dependency scanners check every library version against known vulnerability databases automatically.

twist.text: Transitive dependencies are the hidden risk. A dependency of a dependency can be the weakest link.

climax.text: A scanner flags a nested library with a critical CVE. The team updates it before any exposure.

punchline.text: You're responsible for your dependencies' flaws too. Scan them.
